data.long_meaning: The name Nakul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nakula', which means 'younger brother'. historical_references.reference: In the ancient Indian epic Mahabharata, Nakul is one of the five Pandava brothers and the twin brother of Sahadeva. They were the sons of Pandu and Madri.
Another reference to Nakul can be found in the Puranas, specifically the Siva Purana. Here, Nakul is mentioned as one of the eight sons of Lord Siva and Goddess Parvati.
